title: Fast-rising Duo, The Nike Boyz drops their recent single "Margiela"
htmlContent:
Fast-rising hip hop Duo, The Nike Boyz, has once again greased the music with their incredible talents with the release of their recent trek, "Margiela." They are T. N. B. Music, a new and upcoming duo that moved from Dallas, Texas, to Los Angeles to entirely chase our passion for music while being in the heart of the industry.

The Nike Boyz, on their recent single "Margiela," embodies the feel in a tangible way of what authentic emceeing sounds like. New hip hop banger describes what rappers wish for from God. They showcase the true art of collaboration as they complement each other to the fullest to let their artistry shine to the fullest.
